desc: Ideation: model marginal costs P_i(2j-1), convex costs, and threshold binary search.
Implement the single-binary-search-on-λ solution with exponential search for hi, cost_gt early-exit, and P sorted with break when P_i > L.
Handle edge cases: M < min P_i returns 0, exponential bounds, duplicates at cutoff, and early cost cap at M.
Validate correctness on both public samples (passed) and confirm the remaining // hi bound is strictly less than the count of marginal-cost-hi units.
